teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching philosophy: I firmly believe that ANY person can learn ANY language. I also believe that people today don’t just learn by reading, but also by observing, watching, interacting and discussing.

Student Talking Time: I work to let my student talk as much as possible, so they get the practice they need and build their confidence in the language. Instead of talking a lot myself, I like to ask questions that get my students thinking and expressing themselves.

Variety: A bored student doesn't learn, so I like to keep things interesting by talking about topics that are important to YOU.

I also have 2 years of experience working in Spain for the Comunidad de Madrid Ministry of Education helping high school students improve their English.

I am also certified in TEFL/TESOL. With a 120 hour TEFL course, I learned the best techniques to teach English as a foreign language. 

As a result of my experience in learning languages, I understand how difficult it can be to learn a new language. I would love to play a supportive role in helping you reach your language goals by providing a positive, judgement free learning environment.
teacher_info.teaching_style: My lessons are tailored to fit each student’s needs, whether they are just starting to learn English, or they have already achieved near fluency. Our first lesson will be used to get to know each other a bit, and for me to determine your level and learn about your language goals. From there, we will determine what kind of lessons will be the most helpful for you. I recognize that everyone learns differently, and so I want our lessons to be as collaborative as possible so you can learn in a way that works for you. Depending on the students needs, sometimes lessons will have more structure, while sometimes we can just have a conversation to practice fluency and confidence in speaking English.

exp_info.description: I have been tutoring French students in English since 2020, and in doing so I have honed my teaching skills. Furthermore, since the tutoring has been mostly over Skype, I have had plenty of practice preparing me for an online teaching position with italki.

As an auxiliar de conversación, I spend my weekdays working with Spanish high school students to help them improve their English. In class, I present English grammar and vocabulary to students through fun games and activities and talk to students in English to help them gain confidence and competence in speaking and understanding English as spoken by a native speaker.

pro_course_detail.description: These lessons are for English language learners who would like to improve their writing skills. pro_course_detail.description: This course is aimed at students who are just beginning their English journey, as well as those who want to improve their grammar and vocabulary. I will adapt the course to your individual needs, and together we will create a solid foundation for your next steps in your English language journey. Our lessons can be focused on developing speaking skills, reading comprehension, listening comprehension, grammar, or all of the above.

pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is for students who would like to improve their argumentation skills in English. Argumentation and debate skills are important in advanced levels of English, and this will give you a space to practice and learn how to strengthen your arguments in debates.

As teacher, my primary goal is to lend a helping hand and offer inspiration. 

So much of language learning is simply related to motivation and interest. These will carry students much farther than grammar books and drills. Consistency is a necessity, along with a real love for the language. I stand both as an accountability partner and a guide.

I am hoping to help anyone, academic or self driven, who wants to study and truly live the beautiful English language.

pro_course_detail.description:
A strong command of the written word in English—and by extension the formal, spoken word—offers today great leverage for both our careers and personal lives. Whether you simply want to strengthen your writing skills in general, or if you have a certain paper, thesis, letter, interview or speech soon due—this lesson is for you. 

We can approach your goal from a variety or angles depending on your desired outcome. 

Practice in speech recitation, pronunciation, specific vocabulary building, formal writing, essay assistance and proofreading are a few examples of possible approaches. 

The general aim of these lessons is to bring you to a higher level of fluency and eloquence while giving you greater power in the formal domain of the English language.

pro_course_detail.title: English Language Through Literature
pro_course_detail.description:
The heart of any language is in its literature. 

There, the ideas, the stories, and the unique turns-of-phrase and rhythms that built the modern spoken language lay waiting to be discovered. These great works give us a world to enter, to participate in, and ultimately to bring into ourselves. They lend themselves to a deeper understanding of the target language and allow us to build a more personal relationship with it. 

The advantages of a literary education are not only aesthetic but, above all, practical. A knowledge of literature exposes the student to a much wider and more powerful range of vocabulary than most conversational courses, while also teaching higher level grammar and syntax, greater comprehension, an ear for eloquence, and important cultural allusions. 

For this type of lesson, you are free to select any classic work of literature, poetry, philosophy, politics, etc. and I will read it with you chapter by chapter, and build lessons based upon your desired outcome. We can spend time on vocabulary, discussing or debating critical themes, or any aspect of your choice. I can also take the lead and offer a general English language literature course, or general assistance in understanding a literary work (a holistic approach). 

This course may appeal especially to college students who are struggling through a difficult English language text, though, this is truly for everyone who wants to deepen and broaden their knowledge of English, and perhaps—just perhaps—learn to enjoy the fruits of their labor.

pro_course_detail.description:
Reading for pleasure is a powerful way to enhance your language skills! 📚✨ Imagine diving into captivating storylines and stunning artwork, all in English. As you explore character designs and artistic styles, you'll naturally build your reading comprehension and expand your vocabulary.

Here’s how the course works:

1️⃣ Assigned Reading 📖: Each week, you’ll be given a set of chapters to read before class. This allows us to have in-depth discussions during our sessions.

2️⃣ In-Class Reading and Discussion 🗣️: During class, we will engage in detailed discussions about the story's progression, its characters, and the new vocabulary learned. We will also predict what will happen next, fostering critical thinking and analytical skills.

Objectives 🎯:

📌 Enhance Reading Comprehension: Understand and interpret complex texts.
📌 Expand Vocabulary: Learn new words and phrases in context.
📌 Sharpen Analytical Skills: Analyze storylines, character development, and themes.
📌 Boost Conversational Fluency: Practice discussing ideas and narratives in English.

What We’ll Explore 🌟:

Digital Comics 📱:

The digital comics used in the course are free and accessible online. Expect works from creators like Rachel Smythe (Lore Olympus), Megan Kearney (Beauty and the Beast), and Sarah Andersen (Sarah’s Scribbles).

Illustrated Novels 📚:

For the novels, you’ll need to purchase them. We’ll explore works by authors such as Neil Gaiman (Sandman, Coraline), Brian K. Vaughan (Saga, Y: The Last Man), and Marjorie Liu (Monstress), 

The goal of these lessons is to enhance your reading, analytical, and critical thinking skills, leading to more fluent conversations in English.

During a trial lesson, we can discuss the details of purchasing novels and accessing digital comics.

course_info.trial_description:
This class is for the student and teacher to have a little chat and get to know one another, it is not a sample class and I will not be teaching a regular class during the trial, the trial class is meant to discuss goals, expectations, learning styles and interests so that I can design your learning plan.
In this 30 minute trial, I take a few minutes to talk to the student and get to know him/her/them. I find out their approximate English level, as well as, their academic and professional goals relating to English. Next, I discuss their personal interests and hobbies which help me put together a learning plan that will be interesting for the student. Finally, I explain the format of my classes and give them a pdf file outlining the structure of General and Business classes. 
*Important: Please fill out a teacher form before booking the trial class, this will help me be better prepared for the trial*

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational/Free Speak
pro_course_detail.description:
In this "Free Speak", relaxed style of class, we talk about various different topics ranging from current events to personal interests of the student. This speaking time is great for the teacher to listen to and identify pronunciation, grammar and vocabulary mistakes and allows a relaxed and laid back approach to corrections!
Note: Please make sure that you speak in more than one or two words, this class is meant for the student to talk and be heard.

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction (North American Neutral Accent)
pro_course_detail.description:
As of 3/29/2024 I will only be offering 45 and 30 minute classes of this specific lesson. If you have already booked 1 hour lessons, we will continue to do those until the end of your package. 
In these lessons, I break down each of the sounds that ESL students struggle with the most. We use diagrams, mouth positioning exercises and listening exercises to really get into the physical reason behind why accents happen. I emphasize and practice intonation and cadence in class. I focus on helping the student perfect the pronunciation of some of the most difficult sounds in the English language such as "schwa", long & short vowel sounds, consonant endings and the dreaded "r" sound amongst others.

pro_course_detail.title: General/Writing English Lessons with Material Provided
pro_course_detail.description:
In these general English lessons I provide the materials for the student. We work on listening, speaking, vocabulary, reading, writing and grammar exercises. Each lesson is taught surrounding a particular topic and I aim to tailor the class topics according to the students' interests, for example, if a student likes Art, I try to provide Art related lessons.
We go over each exercise together where I explain, answer questions, correct pronunciation and have speaking moments with the student. Book a trial with me!

pro_course_detail.title: Business English/Career English/Professional English/Work Related English
pro_course_detail.description:
In these classes I provide the study material to the student and we work on business vocabulary, business idioms and business phrasal verbs. We discuss business situations, for example, leading a meeting or making an appointment. 
We also learn how to write business emails and do listening and speaking exercises. Last but not least, I teach students about business etiquette and business culture in the United States.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Lawyers and Law Students and Job Interview Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn legal English and prepare for a job interview at an American law firm!
I have extensive experience in the job interview process as I have interviewed and hired several different candidates in my past career in the Legal field. In these classes we use my experience to prepare the student for their upcoming interview. We learn how to write proper resumes and cover letters. 
We practice how to answer questions properly, proper etiquette and what to ask. I also do several mock interviews with the student where I provide feedback so the student can improve every weak point.
